extracted.name: Summer Veggie Salad
extracted.description: Take this refreshing, colorful summer veggie salad recipe to picnics. It makes the best of summertime vegetables, and adding chicken makes it a meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Place corn into a large pot and cover with water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain; cool corn. Cut kernels from cobs.
Combine corn kernels, avocados, tomatoes, black beans, cilantro, onion, and jalapeño in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lime zest, and lime juice together in a bowl; pour over corn mixture and toss to coat. Refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.
